effective_input.effective_decoded: Pick the light cuvette from white rack slot A1 and transport it to the candidate far hinge internal seat of the single open instrument. Insert, transfer support, open both fingers, retreat and leave the vessel stable. The selected target is candidate far hinge, the internal seat farther from the lid hinge among the two seats. Nominal task geometry: loading depth 27 mm, cuvette height 67.5 mm, and 40.5 mm of the cuvette remaining above the seat entrance at the nominal loaded pose. These are static configured task goals, not measurements of the current vessel pose, insertion depth or support. Static robot calibration: TCPpose is the world pose of frame right gripper, not the panda hand/palm origin. The fixed transform from right gripper coordinates into parent frame panda hand has translation [0.0, 0.0, 0.1] metres and quaternion [0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
